runs.method: Original separate real logs require u+y>0,u-y>0. On exactly u>|y|, sqrt((u+y)(u-y))/(u-y)>0 and the identity is zero; retained nodes exclude both boundary rays. Simultaneous specialization verifies the excluded vertex.

c=k+sqrt(k²-1)>1, so c+cos x>=c-1>0. Exact retained global atan chart; its derivative is 1/(k+cos x) by c²+1=2kc. Additional finite evaluations at both conjugate-zero candidates check actual specialization, not the identity proof.
